name: live.release
meaning: The spring an element settles on after the pointer lets go.

name: live.coast
meaning: How long a fling takes to settle back to its resting motion after the pointer lets go.

name: live.revealDelay
meaning: The wait from a drop that succeeds to the first frame of the view that follows.

name: live.lag
meaning: How far a held element's turn or tilt lags behind the pointer, as a time constant.
